svg.title: Green Angle
svg.desc: Interpretive study after a visually inspected primary museum photograph. Approximate geometry; standardized vivid screen colours. Observed six-corner peaked band. Open space below the inner angle is transparent; dimensions describe overall bounds, not band thickness.
svg.metadata: Reference: https://www.thebroad.org/art/ellsworth-kelly/green-angle; object B-KELLY-2P93.15; reviewed 2026-10-27; not a facsimile.
